Occurrences.Kwic: 溈山若無坐斷天下人舌頭。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄; T/T48/T48n2003.xml). Exact actor: Yuanwu Keqin. The complete case distinguishes the headword-bearing turn from surrounding narration and replies.

Occurrences.Kwic: 驢年夢見溈山行云：五洩當時便去，可謂坐斷天下人舌頭。

Source record (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷); X/X82/X82n1571.xml). Exact actor: Fuyan Wenyan. The complete case distinguishes the headword-bearing turn from surrounding narration and replies.

Occurrences.Kwic: 我若作大師，纔見這僧出來，便下禪牀擒住，痛與一頓，教他歸去舉似南嶽，且顯師承有據，自家眼目分明，管取坐斷天下人舌頭。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (宗門拈古彙集): Tianning Qi utters the headword in the comment explicitly introduced under his name; Mazu Daoyi is the master whose case he discusses.

Occurrences.Kwic: 千巖長禪師初祖忌，拈香：九年面壁，坐斷天下人舌頭；
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (列祖提綱錄): Qianyan Yuanzhang utters the phrase in his incense address for Bodhidharma’s memorial; duplicated volume/editorial headings have been removed from the stored KWIC.

Senses.Explanation: To cut off everyone’s tongue is to leave all other speakers without a viable reply or verbal opening. Comments apply the hyperbolic bodily image to a turn, departure, blow, or wall-facing stance whose handling is said to pre-empt the field; it reports a public verdict, not literal mutilation.
